name: frost_mage
notes: The data twin of the Go strategy mage_frost: the same rotation as a file, so that it can be switched against an edited copy. Frost Nova on a mob in melee, Cone of Cold on two or more in front, Fire Blast on a mob in melee, Frostbolt as the filler.
sources: mod-playerbots 79bd428 src/Ai/Class/Mage/Strategy/GenericMageStrategy.cpp (Frost Nova when the melee closes, Fire Blast)
